headline: Quiet day: San Francisco signs a 45-day pause on data centers
body: A quiet Saturday. The one qualifying story was San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie signing a 45-day citywide moratorium on new data centers while planners study their impact, which lifted Tech Backlash by 0.05. Reversion edged up 0.12; most other endings drifted down slightly as earlier news faded. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance edged up to -8.22.
movers_note: Reversion +0.1, from the San Francisco moratorium (+0.07) and fading earlier news (+0.05). Conquerors -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.11).
coming_up: San Francisco's 45-day moratorium can be extended while long-term rules are drafted
